package rulefixtures

// scenario for domain_entity_contains_json_tags_without_boundary_exception: Core domain entities that are directly annotated for API serialization without a deliberate boundary exception.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type Order struct {
	ID        string  `json:"id"`
	UserID    string  `json:"user_id"`
	Total     float64 `json:"total"`
	Status    string  `json:"status"`
	CreatedAt int64   `json:"created_at"`
}

func (o *Order) CalculateTax() float64 {
	return o.Total * 0.1
}

func (o *Order) IsShipped() bool {
	return o.Status == "shipped"
}
